# IconButton

Glyph-only control for utility actions where a label would add noise.

`SuDuAI.IconButton` · Core

## Use

```jsx
<SuDuAI.IconButton icon="…" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SuDuAI.IconButton" icon="…"></x-import>
```

## Notes

Glyph-only 8px-padded control: header utilities, message action rail, sidebar collapse.

## Props (IconButtonProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `icon` * | `string` | Material Symbols ligature name. |
| `size` | `number` | Glyph size in px. Default 18. |
| `variant` | `'surface' \| 'bare'` | surface = filled container chip; bare = transparent until hover. |
| `active` | `boolean` | Active/selected state — raised container and accent glyph. |
| `title` | `string` | Tooltip and accessible label. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |
| `onClick` | `(e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => void` |  |
